acceptanceCriteria: Create a profile using a selected built-in or user-created tuning system, or duplicate a built-in/user profile into a distinct editable identity; keep the source record unchanged and do not start playback.

Persist and present the profile's tuning-system name and reference configuration. Disclose a mismatch before explicit playback, and preserve the saved configuration when current/global settings change.
Edit ordered pitch entries, optional groups, and written/sounding configuration while preserving stable identity and pitch resolution; playback uses the sounding pitch.

Restore profile and pitch selection silently after relaunch and propagate valid profile configuration to Watch with matching resolved frequency. Missing or invalid tuning data must not substitute another pitch.
component: iPhone profile creation, duplication, editing and selection; shared profile configuration and persistence; Watch replica/presentation regression.
componentsAffected: iPhone Profiles sheet and profile editor
Shared TuningProfile model and local persistence
notes: Planning completed and SP-036/T-0046 activated by explicit user direction on 2026-09-29.

Implemented and recorded as Implemented - Not Verified on 2026-09-29 with EV-0044. Parsing, shared-core build, and the iPhone/Watch scheme build passed; automated/UI tests, simulator interaction, and paired/physical Watch checks were not performed.
The shared model already carries tuning-system ID, reference pitch, entry group IDs, and written-to-sounding offset; implement workflow integration without speculative schema expansion.
The predefined source remains immutable; the user's resulting profile is editable. No automatic playback on create, duplicate, edit, selection, or restoration.
Deletion confirmation/Undo and referenced-object impact are assigned to SP-037; culturally specific candidate review remains in SP-038.
rationale: Discovery becomes useful when a musician can safely turn a selected system into a reusable, editable reference profile.
testSteps: Run JT-TEST-042 and JT-TEST-044 for profile identity, create/edit/duplicate, ordered entries, and persistence after relaunch.
Run JT-TEST-046 and JT-TEST-047 for grouping and written/sounding pitch identity and resolution.
Run JT-TEST-048, JT-TEST-052, and JT-TEST-057 for retained reference/mismatch notice, same-name profile distinction, and stop-before-selection behavior.
Run JT-TEST-049 and JT-TEST-060 for immutable built-in duplication, contextual profile browsing, and selection.
Run JT-TEST-061 and JT-TEST-248 for silent working-state restoration and iPhone/Watch profile replica/resolution behavior; distinguish simulator from paired/physical Watch evidence.
